about: Ultrawings is back and it's bigger and better than ever! Return to the skies in 6 all-new aircraft as you complete hundreds of missions across a beautifully stylized, island-themed world!
Our groundbreaking, motion-control system returns! Use your virtual hands to fully interact and control your aircraft. With enhanced haptics you'll actually feel the action! Only for PS VR2!

You'll be unlocking new gameplay throughout this 40 - 60 hour game! One minute you'll be dogfighting enemy bogies in a WW2-era warplane and the next you'll be popping balloons with a dart pistol in the Ultralight.
summary: Pilot 6 aircraft to complete over 300 missions across an island-themed world.
